content: अग्राह्य {%a.%} Not acceptable, that which ought not to be taken or accepted as a gift, present <ab>&c.</ab>; ˚ह्यम् शिवनिर्माल्यं पत्रं पुष्पं फलं जलम्; not to be perceived, admitted or trusted; not to be considered or taken into account. .{@-ह्या@} <ab>N.</ab> of the clay or मृत्तिका which ought not to be taken for purposes of purification.
